content: Search for a canonical indoor-positioning-system reference architecture returned the same three-part decomposition (positioning / spatial map graph / route engine) plus a separate guidance presentation layer. Academic campus implementations (AR@campus; campus navigation thesis papers) repeat it: positioning determines the user position, wayfinding presents directions, route guidance computes and delivers the turn-by-turn path. Useful as corroboration of the component split, but no single normative reference architecture spec was located; treat the split as a consensus convention rather than a standard.
